protected_native_journey.terminal: Commit/cancellation have one durable winner. Unknown/lost custody or uncertain write is recovery_required. Retry reconciles original bound write; cannot issue a new effect. Committed is never reported cancelled. Native sheet cancellation uses existing exact protected action lifecycle; public observers only detach.
